insurer: Star Health and Allied Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: Room, Boarding, Nursing Expenses up to 1% of sum insured per day. Proportionate deduction applies on associated medical expenses if higher room is chosen.

icu.note: ICU charges are covered under Section I(C) but no separate ICU sub-limit or cap is stated; subject to overall SI.

copayment.note: 20% co-payment applies on each and every claim for insured persons whose age at entry is 61 years and above, applicable for fresh and renewal policies under Section I.

sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹12k–₹40k per eye depending on SI. Modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, intra-vitreal injections, etc.) have per-procedure sub-limits varying by SI. Stents limited to bare metal/drug-eluting cobalt-chromium/stainless steel cost.

initial_waiting.note: Expenses for any illness within 30 days from first policy commencement date excluded, except accidents.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage. Reducible via portability/migration credits.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Extensive list including cataract, ENT, thyroid, hernia, joint replacements, gallbladder, kidney stones, gynaec conditions, prostate, varicose veins, transplants, congenital internal diseases, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity is explicitly excluded under Code Excl 18 (childbirth, caesarean, miscarriage, MTP).

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording.

restoration.note: No restoration or reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation medical expenses for 30 days prior to hospitalisation date.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation medical expenses for up to 60 days from date of discharge.

day_care.note: Day care treatments/procedures covered where hospitalisation is less than 24 hours due to technological advancement.

domiciliary.note: No domiciliary hospitalisation benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient hospitalisation covered up to sum insured. Yoga and Naturopathy claims require prior company approval.

organ_donor.note: Organ donor harvesting expenses not explicitly covered; transplant and related surgeries are listed under 24-month specific disease waiting period exclusion.

ambulance.note: Emergency road ambulance up to ₹750 per hospitalisation and overall ₹1,500 per policy period.

modern_treatments.note: Covered but with per-procedure sub-limits varying by sum insured (e.g. robotic surgery, oral chemo, intra-vitreal injections, stem cell therapy, deep brain stimulation, etc.).

consumables.note: Consumables are listed in the 'items subsumed into room/procedure charges' schedule but are not separately payable; no consumables cover rider mentioned.

global_cover.note: Territorial limit explicitly restricts all treatments to India only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage, no claim can be contested except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 15 days for monthly premium mode; 30 days for all other modes. Coverage not available during grace period.

free_look.note: Applicable on new individual policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability allowed as per IRDAI guidelines; apply at least 30 days before renewal.

notable_exclusions.display: Sleep apnea, endocrine disorders, cochlear implants, EECP/chelation therapy, erectile dysfunction, dental (non-accidental), refractive error <7.5D, circumcision

optional_riders.display: Section II: OPD/Outpatient benefit (carry-forward of unutilised amount to next year)
optional_riders.note: Section II OPD benefit is part of the policy but operates as a separate benefit limit; no other riders mentioned.
